# Travis DeShazo

> Travis DeShazo is a Senior Solutions Architect at Addison Group in New Jersey, with a background in backend services, ETL pipelines, and laboratory data integration and more than 10 years of laboratory and pilot-plant domain expertise.

This is Travis DeShazo's professional website. It describes his software engineering work, scientific background, education, and technical interests. The Markdown profile provides a consolidated text version of his professional background.
